== Biography ==
In the '''1861''' England, Wales & Scotland Census, Alexander Glasgow is recorded as a 23-year-old unmarried male. He is listed as the son in the household. He was born in 1838 in Edinburgh, Midlothian, Scotland. At the time of the census, he is residing at Sheriff Hallmains in Newton, Parish of Newton, Midlothian, Scotland. Alexander's occupation is listed as a "Labourer on railway."

In the '''1871''' England, Wales & Scotland Census, Alexander Glasgow is listed as an unmarried male, aged 35. He is recorded as a son in the household. He was born in 1836 in the City of Edinburgh. His occupation is noted as a "Labourer." At the time of the census, he resides at Henry's Row Private in Dalkeith, Midlothian, Scotland.


* Fact: Christening (07 Feb 1836)  , Colinton, Midlothian, Scotland

Confidence concerns this recorded child and the selected father as identified by the held family evidence; maternity and the father’s upstream ancestry are separate.
